name: Brussels sprouts

schedule.notes: Time backwards from first frost — they need 90 to 110 days to mature into cool weather.
Pick from the bottom up as sprouts firm to 1 in. Frost makes them sweet.

harvest.cues: Sprouts 1 to 1.5 in across, firm. Snap off lowest leaves as you go to expose more.
harvest.storageNotes: On the stalk in a cool place 2 weeks; off-stalk in fridge 1 week.

varieties.name: Long Island Improved
varieties.notes: Classic heirloom. Reliable in most climates.

varieties.name: Diablo
varieties.notes: Uniform sprouts, sturdy stalks, holds well in heavy snow.

notes: Long-game crop — plant when summer is hot to harvest after frost. Top the plant 4 weeks before harvest to push energy into the sprouts.
